title: План примирения в холодильнике  (The Reconciliation Plan in the Fridge)

segments.t: Over the phone, Chef Barinov coaches Lyova on how to privately tell Senya and Fedya that the other is ready to apologize. Inspired by the Chef's fridge idea, Max convinces Kostya that locking Nastya and Sasha in the walk-in cooler is the only way to end their feud.
Но он все равно их вынесет.
А, ну тогда давай действовать по твоему плану.
Right, let's take their exchange slowly and unpack the Russian.
'Tell Senya.' Here the Russian phrasing highlights 'say' before landing on 'Senya'.
Но он все равно их вынесет.
'He will bring them out anyway.' The grammar packs 'but' and 'issue' into a tight, idiomatic kitchen exchange.
'And tell Fedya.' Spoken Russian keeps this brisk, leaning on 'and' and finishing on 'say'. Chef Viktor answers right away.
'Otherwise he will be running late.' Chef Viktor brings out the contrast between 'he' and 'already' in a few short words.
'And you tell him.' Here the Russian phrasing highlights 'and' before landing on 'say'.
'Get out into the dining room.' Spoken Russian keeps this brisk, leaning on 'get lost' and finishing on 'restaurant'. Chef Viktor answers right away.
'That is an excellent idea.' Chef Viktor anchors the line on 'this', while 'great!' completes the thought.
'That is a very bad idea.' In Russian, the idea of 'this' flows naturally into 'idea' without extra filler words.
'Girls, the walk-in fridge.' Here the Russian phrasing highlights 'girls' before landing on 'refrigerator'. Chef Viktor answers right away.
А, ну тогда давай действовать по твоему плану.
'Oh, well then let us go with your plan.' The grammar packs 'and' and 'plan' into a tight, idiomatic kitchen exchange.
'Oh right, you do not have one.' Spoken Russian keeps this brisk, leaning on 'and' and finishing on 'there is no'.
'Take it easy, Chef.' Fedya brings out the contrast between 'easier' and 'chef' in a few short words. Chef Viktor answers right away.
'Have you lost your minds?' Chef Viktor chooses the respectful plural 'you' alongside 'went' to keep a polite distance. Now let's listen to the entire scene again without interruption.
Но он все равно их вынесет.
А, ну тогда давай действовать по твоему плану.
